description: The numerical bounded-evaluation code equals \(y+1\) if and only if the optional evaluator succeeds with output \(y\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.bounded_number_some (c : Nat.Partrec.Code) (k x y : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.boundedNumber c k x = y + 1 ↔
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.bounded c k x = some y
